name: voltstock
description: Volt Stock - plataforma SaaS multitenant para estoque visual, QR Code, bipagem e mapa 2D/3D.

scripts.dev: npm run prepare:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @voltstock/shared run build && npm --workspace @voltstock/api run build && npm --workspace @voltstock/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @voltstock/shared run build && npm --workspace @voltstock/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @voltstock/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: npm --workspace @voltstock/shared run lint && npm --workspace @voltstock/api run lint && npm --workspace @voltstock/web run lint
